_revision.label: Teleport System v1 — Final Candidate
_revision.note: No new derivative crops introduced in Revision 2.4. Every fix (closed-state rail removal, diamond rotation, canonical energy-material, four-point sparkles, target-tile containment) is a CSS/JS transform layer over the same full-canvas source images already catalogued below (edge-diamond-energized.png used directly, rotated in-place via CSS transform: rotate() -- no re-cropped or re-exported derivative asset). All entries below are carried forward unchanged from Revision 2.3.2; source_sha256 values were not re-verified in this pass since no source file was touched.
